note: Hand-verified person identities for the built-in football squads (scripts/lib/football-data.mjs, resolvePersons; docs/design/football-squad-identity.md). same: records of one person that the Reep bridge (reep-bridge.json) lacks or rejected; when one of them holds a Reep id, that id stays the person key. distinct: records of different people; neither a Reep link nor the name matcher may join them. nations: the nation of a person whose records disagree, where the fresher-source rule would choose wrong; ids lists every record of the person and nation is a map nation's name. Each entry names the records and the evidence checked. The builder applies entries whose ids the snapshots hold and skips absent ids; a nations entry that decides no conflict stops the build. Reep links rejected and not listed here stay apart (reep-bridge.json, rejected).

same.name: Pedro Gonçalves (Pote)
same.evidence: Reep rpd878e203323a97 links them; the reducer rejected the link only because FM uses the nickname Pote. EA FC 26 and FC 27: Pedro António Pereira Gonçalves, Sporting CP, Portugal, born 1998-06-28, attacking/left midfield. FM 26.3.0: Pote, Sporting CP, Portugal, 27 on 2025-07-01, LW/AM.

same.name: Byron Castillo

Same name, Ecuador, right back, Barcelona SC (EA Barcelona de Guayaquil, FM Barcelona S.C.) in all three snapshots; the only Byron Castillo in each source. Reep rp362e0a39eacf44 holds the FM record only.

nations.name: Nair Tiknizyan
nations.evidence: EA FC 27 files him under Russia (Olympiacos, born 1999-05-12), FM 26.3.0 under Armenia (Crvena zvezda, CA 72); one Reep person (rp9c98e6c31b0b45). His senior caps are Armenia's: 35 caps since his debut against Turkey on 25 March 2023 in UEFA Euro 2024 qualifying (Wikipedia "Nair Tiknizyan", infobox as of 5 October 2026, read 2026-11-10); his Russia caps are U19 (2017) and U21 (2020–2021) only. martj42's goalscorers.csv has his own goal for Armenia against Wales on 18 November 2023.
